text: [{"question": "Which component owns the on-disk KB store (.tree-fs.json + .knowledge-base.yml), and how does the browser reach FastAPI?", "expected": "The Nuxt 3 Web layer owns the on-disk KB store; the browser never hits FastAPI directly (it goes through the Web proxy, no CORS).", "quote": "**Web (Nuxt 3)** is a server-to-server proxy: the browser never hits FastAPI directly (no CORS). It also owns the on-disk KB store (`.tree-fs.json` + `.knowledge-base.yml`)."}, {"question": "How many tools does the kb-mcp (FastMCP) server expose over stdio, and where does its HTTP code live?", "expected": "94 tools; server.py contains zero HTTP code — all HTTP lives in kb_client/client.py.", "quote": "**kb-mcp (FastMCP)** exposes **94 tools** over stdio; `server.py` contains zero HTTP code — all HTTP lives in `kb_client/client.py`."}, {"question": "Under which collection are sub-KB documents stored in L4, and what happens if you search the sub-KB's own UUID?", "expected": "They are stored under the parent KB collection; searching the sub-KB UUID returns 0 results, so you must search the parent instead.", "quote": "sub-KB documents are stored under the parent collection — searching the sub-KB UUID returns 0 results; search the parent instead"}]
